content.comment_body: Hello, I am experiencing issues with the threshold trigger function on [article_no]. It worked fine in previous versions such as [article_no], but not in the latest version. Counting works correctly in simulation mode within the software, but not in the actual [product_name] module.
How do you assess this malfunction? Just stating that it worked in older [product_name] devices but doesn't in [article_no] is not sufficient to understand the problem.

• Which version of the software are you using? • What is the part number of the current unit? • What pulse speed are you using? • Did you test this with a new, simple program? • What happens if you use the FBD version of the code?

I notice the malfunction because input 5 switching does not get counted by the threshold counter. Tried with other inputs, but experienced the same result. In simulation mode (F3), counting works. My software version is [version_no] and the module part number is [article_no].
Pulse speed is below 10 Hz. The attached program is just a small part of a larger application that has been used for years in about 100 implementations.

Greetings, the ladder-style program may be causing issues—perhaps it didn't convert well for this module version. This is a user-to-user forum and we need more details to assist. If no one has had this exact issue before, it may be helpful to try a new project to see if the functionality works with a fresh program. You can also use the support request to contact [company_name] directly.

Based on the manual, [company_name] guarantees signal processing with standard digital inputs only up to 4 Hz. With the part number [article_no], your module is a basic version without fast counter inputs.
Hello [user_name], where did you find information that this module does not support fast counter inputs? According to the manual (revision 11/2017, page 45), it is listed with this feature.
The module you're using is an AC version. All AC versions lack analog inputs and fast counters. These features are only present in DC versions, like 12/24 RCE or 24 CE.
Check this [url]; it references [article_no], which does not include fast inputs. Also, see the two attached pages from the manual.
The module with part number [article_no] is an AC/DC version.
Hello, I have found my own solution. Please refer to the attachment.

analysis.insight_summary: Users receive inconsistent results between simulation and actual operation for a threshold trigger function in the [version_no] of a [product_name] module. While the function works in simulation software, it does not operate properly on the physical device, likely due to hardware limitations in the AC version such as slower pulse input handling and lack of fast counter inputs. There is also confusion among participants regarding which hardware versions support certain features.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that hardware modules will function consistently with their simulation in the software, specifically for features like threshold trigger counting, as seen in earlier module versions.
